title: Ready/Valid Skid Buffer
description: Build a one-entry skid buffer that preserves data when downstream backpressure arrives.
task: Accept input transfers using in_valid/in_ready and present them on out_valid/out_ready without losing or duplicating data. Hold output data stable while stalled.
examples: in_valid=1 and in_ready=1 captures a word
out_valid=1 and out_ready=0 holds out_data stable
constraints: Support back-to-back transfers when downstream is ready.
starterCode:
module skid_buffer #(
  parameter WIDTH = 8
) (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  input in_valid,
  output in_ready,
  input [WIDTH-1:0] in_data,
  output reg out_valid,
  input out_ready,
  output reg [WIDTH-1:0] out_data
);

  // Your RTL here

endmodule

title: Elastic Pipeline Register
description: Implement a single-stage pipeline register with an aligned valid bit.
task: Capture in_data whenever in_valid is asserted and produce the captured value with out_valid on the next cycle.
examples: in_valid with 8'h5A -> out_valid next cycle with 8'h5A
in_valid=0 -> out_valid deasserts next cycle
constraints: Accept a new input every cycle.

title: Asynchronous-Assert Reset Synchronizer
description: Create a two-flop reset synchronizer with asynchronous assertion and synchronous deassertion.
task: When arst_n falls, rst_n must assert immediately. After arst_n rises, rst_n must remain low for two rising clock edges before deasserting.
examples: arst_n=0 -> rst_n=0 immediately
arst_n rises -> rst_n becomes 1 after two clocks

title: Binary to Gray Counter
description: Build a parameterized binary counter and expose its Gray-code representation.
task: Increment the binary state when enable is high and drive gray = binary ^ (binary >> 1).
examples: binary=0 -> gray=0
constraints: Hold state when enable is low.

title: Simple Dual-Port RAM
description: Infer a small synchronous-write, asynchronous-read dual-port memory.
task: Write wdata to waddr on a rising clock edge when we is high. Independently expose the location selected by raddr on rdata.
examples: write address 3 with 0xA5 -> reading address 3 returns 0xA5
constraints: One write port and one read port.
starterCode:
module simple_dpram #(
  parameter WIDTH = 8,
  parameter DEPTH = 16,
  parameter ADDR_W = 4
) (
  input clk,
  input we,
  input [ADDR_W-1:0] waddr,
  input [ADDR_W-1:0] raddr,
  input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata,
  output [WIDTH-1:0] rdata
);

  // Your RTL here

endmodule

title: One-Hot Traffic-Light FSM
description: Implement a three-state one-hot finite-state machine.
task: Cycle RED -> GREEN -> YELLOW -> RED whenever advance is high, otherwise hold the current state.
examples: reset -> RED
RED + advance -> GREEN
GREEN + advance -> YELLOW
constraints: State output is 3-bit one-hot: RED=001, GREEN=010, YELLOW=100.

title: Backpressure-Safe Ready/Valid Source
description: Implement a source register that obeys ready/valid protocol semantics.
task: When load is asserted while the source can accept a new value, capture load_data and assert valid. Keep valid and data stable until ready completes the transfer.
examples: load data while idle -> valid=1
valid=1 and ready=0 -> hold data
valid=1 and ready=1 -> transfer completes
starterCode:
module rv_source #(
  parameter WIDTH = 8
) (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  input load,
  input [WIDTH-1:0] load_data,
  input ready,
  output reg valid,
  output reg [WIDTH-1:0] data,
  output can_load
);

  // Your RTL here

endmodule

title: APB Register Peripheral
description: Build a minimal APB peripheral exposing one 32-bit read/write register.
task: Complete APB accesses in the enable phase. Writes to address 0 update the register; reads from address 0 return it. PREADY may stay high and PSLVERR low.
examples: PSEL=1,PENABLE=1,PWRITE=1 writes PWDATA
read address 0 returns stored value
starterCode:
module apb_reg (
  input PCLK,
  input PRESET,
  input PSEL,
  input PENABLE,
  input PWRITE,
  input [3:0] PADDR,
  input [31:0] PWDATA,
  output [31:0] PRDATA,
  output PREADY,
  output PSLVERR
);

  // Your RTL here

endmodule

title: AXI-Lite Write Register Slave
description: Implement the write side of a single-register AXI-Lite slave.
task: Accept AW and W channels independently, update a 32-bit register once both have handshaken, then issue one OKAY write response.
examples: AW may arrive before W
W may arrive before AW
BVALID remains asserted until BREADY
starterCode:
module axi_lite_write_reg (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  input awvalid,
  input [3:0] awaddr,
  output reg awready,
  input wvalid,
  input [31:0] wdata,
  output reg wready,
  output reg bvalid,
  input bready,
  output [1:0] bresp,
  output reg [31:0] reg0
);

  // Your RTL here

endmodule

title: Parameterized PWM Generator
description: Generate a PWM waveform from an unsigned duty-cycle input.
task: Use a free-running counter and drive pwm high whenever counter is less than duty.
examples: duty=0 -> always low
duty=255 on 8-bit counter -> high for 255 of 256 counts

title: Toggle-Based Pulse Synchronizer
description: Transfer a one-cycle pulse between unrelated clock domains using a toggle synchronizer.
task: Toggle a source-domain bit on each src_pulse, synchronize it through two destination flops, and generate one dst_pulse when the synchronized toggle changes.
examples: one src pulse -> one dst pulse
dst pulse width is exactly one dst clock
constraints: Assume source pulses are spaced far enough apart to be observed.

title: Clock-Enable Data Register
description: Model the FPGA-friendly alternative to fabric clock gating: a register controlled by clock enable.
task: Capture d on each rising edge only when ce is high; otherwise hold q.
examples: ce=1 -> q captures d
ce=0 -> q holds its previous value

title: 32-bit Population Count
description: Build a combinational population-count unit that returns the number of set bits in a 32-bit word.
task: Count all one bits in x and return a value from 0 to 32.
examples: x=0 -> count=0
x=32'hFFFFFFFF -> count=32
x=32'hF0F0F0F0 -> count=16

title: Four-Lane Signed Vector Maximum
description: Implement a four-lane signed max-reduction datapath.
task: Return the greatest signed 16-bit value among x0, x1, x2 and x3.

title: Q1.7 Fixed-Point Multiplier
description: Multiply two signed Q1.7 fixed-point values and return a truncated Q1.7 result.
task: Compute the signed 8x8 product, arithmetic-shift the Q2.14 result right by 7 fractional bits, and return the low signed 8-bit Q1.7 value.
constraints: Inputs and output are signed 8-bit two's-complement.

title: Valid-Ready Streaming Accumulator
description: Build a streaming accumulator that updates only on successful ready/valid transfers.
task: Whenever in_valid && in_ready is true, add signed in_data to acc. clear synchronously resets the accumulator. This sink is always ready when not in reset.
examples: valid sample 3 then -1 -> acc=2
in_valid=0 -> accumulator holds
starterCode:
module stream_accum (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  input clear,
  input in_valid,
  output in_ready,
  input signed [15:0] in_data,
  output reg signed [31:0] acc
);

  // Your RTL here

endmodule

title: 2x2 Matrix Multiply Datapath
description: Implement a small combinational 2x2 signed matrix-multiply datapath.
task: Given signed 8-bit matrices A and B, compute C=A*B with four signed 18-bit outputs.
examples: identity A -> C equals B
all-ones matrices -> every output equals 2
starterCode:
module matmul2 (
  input signed [7:0] a00,
  input signed [7:0] a01,
  input signed [7:0] a10,
  input signed [7:0] a11,
  input signed [7:0] b00,
  input signed [7:0] b01,
  input signed [7:0] b10,
  input signed [7:0] b11,
  output reg signed [17:0] c00,
  output reg signed [17:0] c01,
  output reg signed [17:0] c10,
  output reg signed [17:0] c11
);

  // Your RTL here

endmodule

title: Three-Tap INT8 Convolution
description: Create the arithmetic core of a small 1D convolution engine.
task: Compute signed x0*k0 + x1*k1 + x2*k2 combinationally using signed INT8 operands.
starterCode:
module conv3_int8 (
  input signed [7:0] x0,
  input signed [7:0] x1,
  input signed [7:0] x2,
  input signed [7:0] k0,
  input signed [7:0] k1,
  input signed [7:0] k2,
  output reg signed [17:0] y
);

endmodule

examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: 16-bit Magnitude Comparator

examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: 8-bit Barrel Shifter
description: Shift an 8-bit word left or right by 0-7 positions in one combinational stage.
task: Use dir=0 for left shift and dir=1 for right shift.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Leading-Zero Counter
description: Count the number of leading zeros in an 8-bit value.
task: Return count=8 for an all-zero input; otherwise count zeros before the highest set bit.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: 8-bit Population Count
description: Count how many bits are set in an 8-bit input.
task: Produce a 4-bit result from 0 through 8.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Four-Input Min/Max
description: Find the minimum and maximum of four unsigned 8-bit values.
task: Produce min_value and max_value combinationally.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Even-Parity Generator
description: Generate the parity bit required to make an 8-bit word have even parity.
task: Use reduction XOR so data plus parity contains an even number of ones.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Register with Clock Enable
description: Build an 8-bit register that updates only when enable is high.
task: Reset clears q. When enable=1 capture d; otherwise hold q.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Toggle Flip-Flop
description: Toggle an output bit whenever toggle_en is asserted.
task: Reset drives q low; otherwise invert q on enabled cycles.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Sticky Status Flag
description: Latch an event until software explicitly clears it.
task: event sets flag. clear clears flag. Reset has highest priority, then clear, then event.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Pulse Stretcher
description: Stretch a one-cycle input pulse into a four-cycle output pulse.
task: On pulse_in load a counter with 4. Keep pulse_out high while the counter is nonzero.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: 4-Cycle Delay Line
description: Delay an 8-bit sample by exactly four clock cycles.
task: Shift input data through four registers every rising clock edge.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Serial-to-Parallel Receiver
description: Collect eight serial bits into one parallel byte.
task: On each enable cycle shift serial_in into bit 0. Pulse valid after eight samples.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: 1011 Sequence Detector
description: Detect the serial bit pattern 1011 with overlapping matches allowed.
task: Pulse match for one cycle when the newest bits complete 1011.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Request/Acknowledge Controller
description: Control a request/acknowledge transaction.
task: IDLE waits for start, REQUEST asserts req until ack, DONE pulses done then returns to IDLE.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Pedestrian Crossing FSM

task: WAIT keeps cars green. A pedestrian request moves to STOP, then WALK, then returns to WAIT when timer_done is asserted.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Timeout and Retry FSM
description: Retry a request after a timeout, up to three attempts.
task: ISSUE asserts req, WAIT waits for ack or timeout, SUCCESS pulses done, FAIL pulses error after the third timed-out attempt.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Packet Header Parser FSM
description: Parse a four-byte header followed by payload bytes.
task: Consume SYNC, TYPE, LENGTH, FLAGS in order. Assert payload_phase after the fourth header byte until packet_done.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Four-Beat Burst Controller
description: Control a fixed four-beat streaming burst.
task: On start enter SEND. Assert valid and advance beat only when ready. Pulse done after the fourth accepted beat.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Vending Machine FSM

task: Track credit states 0,5,10. Pulse vend whenever the total reaches or exceeds 15 and return to zero credit.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Start/Busy/Done Controller
description: Implement a standard operation-control shell with start, busy and one-cycle done.
task: IDLE waits for start. BUSY remains active until operation_done. DONE pulses done for one cycle then returns to IDLE.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Counted Synchronous FIFO
description: Build an 8-entry synchronous FIFO with an occupancy count.
task: Increment count on successful write-only cycles, decrement on read-only cycles, hold on simultaneous read/write.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: FIFO Almost-Full / Almost-Empty Flags

task: almost_full must assert at count>=14. almost_empty must assert at count<=2.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: First-Word Fall-Through Buffer
description: Implement a two-entry first-word fall-through queue.
task: When non-empty, dout must reflect the oldest stored word without waiting for rd_en.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: FIFO Overflow / Underflow Sticky Flags
description: Record illegal FIFO access attempts.
task: Set overflow if wr_en occurs while full. Set underflow if rd_en occurs while empty. Flags remain set until clear or reset.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Two-Entry Elastic Buffer
description: Build a two-entry ready/valid elastic queue.
task: in_ready must deassert only when both entries are occupied. out_valid reflects whether at least one entry is occupied.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Packet FIFO Boundary Tracker
description: Track packet-end metadata alongside FIFO data.
task: Store last_in together with each accepted data word and reproduce it as last_out when that word reaches the output.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Circular Sample Buffer
description: Continuously retain the most recent eight samples.
task: Write every enabled sample at wr_ptr and wrap the pointer modulo eight.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.

title: Single-Entry Bypass Buffer
description: Pass data combinationally when empty, but capture it if downstream stalls.
task: When storage is empty, out_valid/in_data may bypass directly. If out_ready is low, retain the item until consumed.
examples: Implement the stated behavior for all legal input combinations.
